name: Ricardo Vargas
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly while working as a supply chain analyst for a mining company in Peru. He quickly recognized the similarities between managing complex logistical operations in mining and the high-pressure environment of racing. After earning a certificate in Motorsport Management, Ricardo joined a local rally team as a volunteer, eventually transitioning to a paid role managing their parts inventory and transportation. 

He approaches his role with a laser focus on efficiency and accuracy. Ricardo believes that success in motorsport logistics depends on meticulous planning, proactive communication, and an unrelenting attention to detail. He is known for his ability to anticipate potential problems and implement solutions before they impact track performance, a skill honed through years of experience dealing with unpredictable logistical challenges in remote environments. His demanding nature stems from his commitment to excellence; he pushes his team to meet his high standards, ensuring that every component is in its place and ready to go when needed.

Ricardo's passion extends beyond the technical aspects; he sees logistics as a vital part of the team's strategy, contributing directly to their competitive advantage. He’s not just moving parts; he’s enabling victory.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a color-coded spreadsheet system for all inventory, even for the smallest items.
Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas or potential problems.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
